description: This PHP test class tests the EmployeePictureService class within the OrangeHRM application's Pim Service module. It covers methods related to retrieving, saving employee pictures, handling permissions, adjusting image sizes, and computing ETags for caching.

classes.name: EmployeePictureServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for EmployeePictureService checking picture retrieval, permission handling, size adjustment, saving, and ETag calculation.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePictureDao
methods.description: Tests that the service returns an instance of EmployeePictureDao.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of employee picture when user has access.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleEmpPictureByEmpNumberNotAllowed
methods.description: Ensures no picture is retrieved when user lacks access rights.

methods.name: testGetEmpPictureByEmpNumber
methods.description: Tests direct retrieval of employee picture by employee number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeePicture
methods.description: Verifies saving an employee picture returns the correct object.

methods.name: testPictureSizeAdjust
methods.description: Validates that images are resized proportionally to 200px maximum dimension.

methods.name: getPictureSizeAdjustDataProvider
methods.description: Provides image data and expected resize results for testing images of various dimensions.

methods.name: testGetETagByEmpPicture
methods.description: Tests the generation of ETag headers for caching based on employee picture content.
